test_name: Audit and Accountability - AU-3 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Reporting-Service-027
Primary NIST family: Audit and Accountability (AU); evidence focus: AU-3.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: audit logs are written to an immutable, access-restricted archive with integrity monitoring. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
